DEFENDANT AIMEE OLMOS IS REQUESTING FOR A SPANISH INTERPRETER, COURT DOES NOT HAVE ONE AVAILABLE DUE TO LAST-MINUTE REQUEST. NO PROOF OF SERVICE ON FILE ON DEFENDANT AIMEE OLMOS. PLAINTIFF PRESENT PROOF OF SERVICE ON DEFENDANT AIMEE OLMOS WHICH HAS NOT BEEN FILED WITH THE COURT, ALSO IT SHOWS THE CLAIM WAS SERVED ON 12-10-2022 WHICH IS 15 DAYS UNTIMELY. MATTER IS CONTINUED FOR CURING UNTIMELY PROOF OF SERVICE AND PLAINTIFF HAS BEEN INSTRUCTED TO FILE PROOF OF SERVICE AT THE CLERK'S OFFICE AT LEAST 5 DAYS BEFORE THE NEXT COURT DATE. PLAINTIFF DOES NOT NEED TO RE-DO PROOF OF SERVICE ON DEFENDANT AIMEE OLMOS. PROOF OF SERVICE ON JOSE MARTIN SERVED BY SHERIFF'S ON 10-27-22 IS ON FILE. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. VISITING JUDGE RONALD QUIDACHAY; CLERK: D. AU. NOT REPORTED. (D506)
